website.note: Single-asset company — brilaroxazine (RP5063) for schizophrenia and other neuropsychiatric/respiratory indications

pipeline.modality: Small molecule (oral) — multimodal serotonin-dopamine signaling modulator

indications.trial_design: RECOVER-1 Phase 3 randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled (Part 1, 4-week acute, NCT05184335) plus 12-month open-label long-term safety (Part 2 OLE) — both completed with positive results. RECOVER-2 confirmatory Phase 3 protocol cleared by FDA, similar design to RECOVER
indications.trial_status: RECOVER-1 completed (positive); RECOVER-2 trial-related activities planned to initiate Q2 2026 with US patient enrollment Q3 2026; expected completion Q4 2027
key_milestones: RECOVER-1 Part 1 (acute) and Part 2 (12-month OLE long-term safety) completed
NDA submission planned upon completion of RECOVER-2

excluded_preclinical: Brilaroxazine for Bipolar Disorder (BD), Major Depressive Disorder (MDD) and ADHD — Phase 2 plans only, contingent on additional financing, potentially as early as H1 2027
Brilaroxazine for Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension (PAH) — FDA Orphan Drug designation (2016), preclinical only; Phase 2 contingent on financing
Brilaroxazine for Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis (IPF) — preclinical; Phase 2 contingent on financing
excluded_legacy_terminated: RP5063 Phase 2 in acute schizophrenia/schizoaffective (NCT01490086, completed 2013)
